conclusions.proven: Current AmdSetup fields and APCB MEMG/DFG structures are reproducibly located and parsed from two matching reads; IFR supplies option labels and exact types for the listed fields.
conclusions.inferred: Historical profile notes associate 0x316/0x330/0x704 with clock relationships and 0x6E5/0x6E6 with a voltage-offset control/value pair; the physical effects are not proven. Historical host source maps SMU metrics fields to current UCLK/FCLK/SOCCLK/voltage values, but its exact BC-250 driver/source revision and runtime relationship are not established.
conclusions.not_proven: Memory synchronization, training success, SMU application, actual SoC/GFX rail voltage, stability, or bootability of any changed value.
conclusions.candidate_status: APCB-only VCN and one-field MemoryClock candidates exist; no SoC-voltage candidate has been built.
conclusions.historical_claims: Imported OC/SoC documents provide useful field leads but their voltage-unit/safety and post-profile behavior claims are not current proof and conflict with the corrected u32 IFR interpretation; they are retained as historical references only.
conclusions.soc_review: Root static review confirms field location/type/control but leaves physical unit/sign/encoding and exact consumer inconclusive; no SoC-voltage candidate is permitted.
conclusions.cbs_defaults: CbsBasePei direct context corroborates the current default field bytes and widths but does not establish downstream application.

source_traces.observation: Host metric API exposes current SOC/GFX voltage and current clock fields; UCLK and FCLK are assigned from the same MemclkFrequency member in this imported source.
source_traces.limit: does not decode AmdSetup NVRAM fields or prove running revision

source_traces.observation: PMFW feature bit definitions include FCLK_DPM=5, SOC_DPM=13, UMC_THROTTLE=23, DF_THROTTLE=24.
source_traces.limit: feature bit definitions do not prove field consumer or current feature state

source_traces.observation: Runtime API source separates direct VID/mV methods, current voltage queries, clock methods, and float VID offset methods; e.g. q3 0x36/0x37 return current voltage in mV by source comments, q3 0x4D/0x4E pack float offsets, and q3 0x42 returns a SoC DPM clock value.
source_traces.limit: The API contains write-capable methods and does not map AmdSetup+0x6E6 to an exact runtime command; it was not executed.

source_traces.observation: Imported host codec converts mV to/from a VID code and packs large offsets as IEEE float; this is a separate runtime protocol context.
source_traces.limit: Conversion formulas do not establish BIOS NVRAM field encoding or platform acceptance.

source_traces.observation: Queue-2 source exposes feature-mask and droop-calibration methods with mV comments; these are write-capable runtime operations.
source_traces.limit: Never execute without separate per-call approval; no AmdSetup field mapping.

source_traces.observation: The helper opens PCI config O_RDWR; read_smu_reg writes the selector at 0xB8 before reading 0xBC, and send_message writes mailbox state. Query method names do not make the hardware operation read-only.
source_traces.limit: Do not execute this helper under a read-only gate; no hardware operation was performed.

source_traces.observation: Direct disassembly shows Q2 response/argument/command addresses passed through the SMU service helper; the path is write-capable at hardware level and no AmdSetup+0x6E6 data flow is established.
source_traces.limit: Rizin decompilation has no symbols and this report does not prove runtime execution or voltage-field consumption.

source_traces.observation: NBIO PEI generic DF helper has direct read, write, and read-modify-write operations through 0x405C/0x4098.
source_traces.limit: No AmdSetup VDD field data flow or VCN-specific consumer is proven; no hardware operation.

source_traces.observation: CbsBasePei fcn.000004C0 writes default structure fields: MemoryClockSpeed/UclkDiv1M0=0xFF, FclkDpm=0x0F, VDDCR_VDD control=0/value=0, DF control=0xFF/value=0x3E8, and default power/current values.
source_traces.limit: This is a default-structure initializer; it does not prove the user NVAR is read, the SMU consumes each field, or memory training applies them.
